thread:
Marina: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting a one-page account health + onboarding checklist for the Acme pilot. Goal: include practical guidance customers can follow for prefetching/caching, request grouping (batching), and streaming fallbacks. Putting a first draft here.

Devin: Love it. Can we keep it customer-facing (non-technical short bullets) + an appendix with config snippets? :thumbsup:

Oliver: Agreed. Also add a short section for renewal-risk signals (latency spikes, rising error rate, low token utilization). One line per signal and recommended action.

Marina: Yes on both. Draft outline: 1) Quick health checklist for CSMs 2) 0-30 day onboarding steps (low effort wins) 3) Best-practice card for performance (prefetch/cache, group requests, streaming) 4) Telemetry & alerts to watch 5) Playbook for renewal risk -> escalation.

Sai: Can you include the exact SDK flags customers should try first? Our pilot asked for copy-paste examples. Keep defaults conservative.

Devin: Suggested customer copy for the performance card (short):
- "Enable prefix caching for repeated prompts to reduce token cost by up to 40%."
- "Group similar short requests into batches of 4-8 to improve throughput; avoid batching if you need single-request p99 latency."
- "Use streaming for long responses to improve perceived latency; fall back to non-streamed when tokens are small or unstable networks."

Marina: Nice. Appendix snippet (Dev-facing) — paste into guide:```
# Recommended V1 config
cache:
  enable_kv_cache: true
  prefix_keys: ["/v1/dialogue", "/v1/summaries"]
batching:
  max_batch_size: 8
  max_wait_ms: 20
streaming:
  enabled: true
  chunk_ms: 30
```

Oliver: Add a note: "If high variability in sequence length, set max_wait_ms lower to avoid tail latency". Also remind customers to pin a model variant for stable perf during canary rollouts.

Marina: Telemetry checklist (short):
- track p50/p95/p99 latency per route
- token-per-request distribution
- cache hit rate by prefix
- failed_request_rate and error classes
- batch size distribution
Actionable thresholds: p95 > 800ms or cache hit < 30% => schedule enablement sync.

Sai: For renewal risks, propose these signals + actions:
- sustained p95 degradation (7d) -> prioritize infra review + canary rollback
- sudden jump in error rate -> open P1 incident, notify AE
- usage plateau with low feature adoption -> run enablement workshop + troubleshooting doc
- billing surprises -> reach out to PM for quota review

Devin: Operational playbook lines (short):
- On sign-up (day 0): send quick guide + recommended config snippet, offer 30-min joint setup.
- Week 1: review telemetry, confirm cache prefixes and batching settings.
- Week 2-3: optimize batch sizes per latency targets, enable streaming where helpful.
- Ongoing: monthly health review, renew risk check at 60 days.

Marina: Can someone flag a renewal-risk example to include as an anonymized case study? Need one paragraph.

Oliver: I'll redact and paste a short case: "Customer X saw p95 grow 2x after enabling a long prefix strategy; root cause was unbounded context growth. We added prefix evictions and limited KV size, regained SLA within 24h."

Marina: Perfect. @Devin can you turn this into a single-page PDF and drop in the playbook repo? Also add a short 'how to escalate' matrix.

Devin: Yep — I'll create the PDF and put it under /playbooks/customer-health/ then DM the link. ETA end of day. :thumbsup:

cs-bot: Reminder — new doc created: /playbooks/customer-health/health-checklist-prefetching-2026-03.pdf by Devin.

Marina: Thanks all. I'll run this by the AE for Acme tomorrow and schedule the enablement session if they want it. Posting final draft here after PDF is up. :wave:
